name: Cutlet Pao
instructions: 1. Pound the meat slices until thin and tenderize well.
2. Marinate the meat with ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric, cumin, vinegar, and salt for at least one hour.
3. Dip each marinated slice into the beaten egg and coat thoroughly with semolina.
4. Heat oil in a pan and shallow fry the cutlets on medium-high heat until they are golden brown and crispy on both sides.
5. Slit the Goan Pao horizontally and lightly toast it if desired.
6. Place the hot, crispy cutlet inside the pao, top with fresh chopped onions and coriander, and serve immediately.
description: Cutlet Pao is an iconic Goan street food staple, representing the fusion of Portuguese culinary influence and local Indian flavors. It is a quintessential quick meal found in roadside stalls and taverns across Goa, celebrated for its perfect contrast between the crispy, spicy meat cutlet and the pillowy, soft local bread.
